tour.title: Project Entry Points
tour.description: Cargotracker is a Django project. Settings define installed apps (one per bounded context), URLs route requests to each context, and WSGI/ASGI expose the app to servers.
tour.languageLesson: Django projects are configured by a settings module and a root URLconf that includes per-app URL modules.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate Core
tour.description: The cargo domain is the heart of the DDD design. The Cargo aggregate root owns a tracking id, a route specification and an itinerary, all modelled as immutable value objects.
tour.languageLesson: Frozen dataclasses give value objects immutability and equality by value.

tour.title: Delivery and Handling Activity
tour.description: Delivery derives transport, routing and misdirection status from the itinerary and the handling history. This keeps business rules in the domain layer rather than in views.

tour.title: Supporting Domains
tour.description: Location and Voyage are separate bounded contexts supplying UN/LOCODE locations and scheduled carrier movements that cargo itineraries refer to.

tour.title: Repositories and Persistence
tour.description: Domain layers declare abstract repositories; infrastructure layers implement them with Django ORM records and map between models and domain objects. Re-exporting models lets Django discover them.

tour.title: Booking Application Services
tour.description: Booking services register new cargo, request candidate routes, change destinations or deadlines, and feed the dashboard. They orchestrate domain objects through repositories.

tour.title: Pathfinder Routing
tour.description: The pathfinder context computes shortest transit paths and exposes them as a JSON API, which booking calls to propose itineraries.

tour.title: Booking Web UI
tour.description: Booking views implement the admin dashboard, the multi-step registration wizard, modal dialogs and route selection, rendered with HTMX-enabled templates.
tour.languageLesson: Django templates extend a base layout and fill named blocks; HTMX swaps partial templates into the page.

tour.title: Handling Event Ingestion
tour.description: Handling reports arrive via REST, are stored as queued registration attempts, then processed asynchronously by a management command that creates handling events.

tour.title: Public Tracking
tour.description: Customers look up a cargo by tracking id. The tracking application service and interface helpers format status, ETA, next activity and history for display.

tour.title: Maps
tour.description: Map features convert cargo status and coordinates into an embeddable map frame for tracking, plus an admin map covering all cargo.

tour.title: Composition and Data Tooling
tour.description: Composition roots wire repositories into application services. Management commands seed sample data and export or load database snapshots.
